title: 第19章 帝京叶家之女第20章 都听哥哥的
content_zh:
其中一个很漂亮的女孩子说着就上来握住陈景言的手。她指尖微凉，声音却带着灼热的期待。
陈景言愣住了，眼前女孩的眼眸如深潭般幽静，那张脸很陌生。
他对这个女子一点印象都没有。
“哥哥，你好好看看我。你救过我的命。”
看着女孩子期待的眼神，陈景言也不知道该说什么好了。
陈景言的过去他一无所知，只有在陈家这痴傻三年，有一些零星的记忆碎片。之前的事情，他一无所知。
他默默注视着女孩的眼睛，试图从中捕捉一丝熟悉的影子，却只看到女孩子那清澈的眸子里自己茫然的倒影。
这个女孩子十分漂亮，五官精致得如同画中人，一颦一笑都带着摄人心魄的美感。
她的身材高挑匀称，一袭长裙勾勒出优雅的曲线，前凸后翘，裙摆随风轻扬，更显灵动飘逸。
他现在是个傻子，只能继续装傻充愣。
“嘿嘿嘿......傻子，你是傻子。”
说完，陈景言转身就要走，可那女孩猛地拽住他的手腕，力道很大，她的修为竟远超常人。
“哥哥，你知不知道我找了你三年，我不会再让你离开我了。”
女孩子向她的跟班使了个眼色，又有两个女孩子上来缠住他。
这两个人的修为更高，已经是地境大圆满。
年纪轻轻就有这样的修为，真不错，而且只是这个漂亮女孩子的跟班，说明这个女孩子的来头一定不小。
他们的行为勾起陈景言的好奇心了，他想看看她们到底想干什么？
几个女孩子前呼后拥，簇拥着陈景言来到一辆豪华车上。
车子启动，后面又跟上来两辆豪车。
这阵仗还真不小，看来，她们早就做好准备，蓄势待发。只等着他的出现。

车子来到一栋大楼前停下来。
大楼门口，红毯铺地，两侧站满黑衣保镖。女孩挽住陈景言的手臂，笑意盈盈：“哥哥，这是我的公司，你以后就给我当ceo吧。”
陈景言傻傻地笑着问道：“ceo是什么东西，好玩吗？”
女孩子一时间愣住了，其他女子忍不住笑出声来。
可漂亮女孩冷冷的目光扫视她们的时候，她们吓得立刻闭嘴了。
漂亮女孩接着说道：“哥哥，当ceo很好玩的，这里的人都得听你的。”
“好玩，真好玩。”
陈景言继续装傻，可他真是搞不懂了，这么漂亮的女孩子，难道是一个恋爱脑吗？她和陈景言到底是什么关系？
content_en:
One of the very beautiful girls came up and held Chen Jingyan's hand. Her fingertips were slightly cold, but her voice was filled with burning anticipation.
Chen Jingyan was stunned. The girl in front of him had eyes as quiet as a deep pool, and that face was very unfamiliar.
He had no impression of this woman at all.
"Brother, take a good look at me. You saved my life."
Seeing the expectant look in the girl's eyes, Chen Jingyan didn't know what to say.
He knew nothing about Chen Jingyan's past. He only had some sporadic memory fragments from his three stupid years in the Chen family. He knew nothing about what happened before.
He silently stared into the girl's eyes, trying to catch a familiar shadow, but he only saw his blank reflection in the girl's clear eyes.
This girl is very beautiful, her facial features are as delicate as the one in the painting, and her every move and smile carries a breathtaking beauty.
She has a tall and well-proportioned figure, and her long skirt outlines elegant curves, with the front and back curved, and the hem of the skirt flutters gently in the wind, making her more agile and elegant.
He is a fool now and can only continue to act stupid.
"Hey hey hey...fool, you are a fool."
After saying that, Chen Jingyan turned around and was about to leave, but the girl grabbed his wrist with great force. Her cultivation was far beyond ordinary people.
"Brother, do you know that I have been looking for you for three years, and I will never let you leave me again."
The girl winked at her follower, and two more girls came up to pester him.
The cultivation level of these two people is higher, and they have reached the Great Perfection.
It's really good to have such cultivation at such a young age, and he's just a follower of this beautiful girl, which shows that this girl must have a lot of background.
Their behavior aroused Chen Jingyan's curiosity. He wanted to see what they wanted to do?
Several girls shouted in front of them and surrounded Chen Jingyan to a luxury car.
The car started, and two luxury cars followed behind.
This battle is really not small. It seems that they have been prepared for a long time and are ready to go. Just waiting for him to appear.
The car came to a stop in front of a building.
At the entrance of the building, a red carpet was spread on the floor, and bodyguards in black stood on both sides. The girl took Chen Jingyan's arm and smiled: "Brother, this is my company, you can be my CEO from now on."
Chen Jingyan asked with a silly smile: "What is a CEO? Is it fun?"
The girl was stunned for a moment, and the other women couldn't help laughing.
But when the beautiful girl glanced at them coldly, they were so frightened that they shut up immediately.
The pretty girl continued: "Brother, being a CEO is fun. Everyone here has to listen to you."
"It's fun, it's really fun."
Chen Jingyan continued to act stupid, but he really couldn't understand. Could such a beautiful girl be a love brain? What is the relationship between her and Chen Jingyan?
